Raw digital HTML/XML, scan crops and source bytes remain recoverable. Comparisons may fold case and ae/æ; display text does not.

div.head: Whiston’s chapter headings (compiled index)
div.note: These headings are transcribed from the 1856 Auburn and Rochester printing of William Whiston’s translation. Their arrangement as an index is editorial; this is not a reproduction of an original printed table of contents.
div.head: BOOK XI.
div.p: CONTAINING THE INTERVAL OF TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTY-THREE YEARS FIVE MONTHS.
FROM THE FIRST OF CYRUS TO THE DEATH OF ALEXANDER THE GREAT.

list.label: I
list.item: HOW CYRUS, KING OF THE PERSIANS, DELIVERED THE JEWS OUT OF BABYLON, AND SUFFERED THEM TO RETURN TO THEIR OWN COUNTRY, AND TO BUILD THEIR TEMPLE; FOR WHICH WORK HE GAVE THEM MONEY.
list.label: II
list.item: HOW, UPON THE DEATH OF CYRUS, THE JEWS WERE HINDERED IN BUILDING OF THE TEMPLE BY THE CUTHEANS, AND THE NEIGHBOURING GOVERNORS; AND HOW CAMBYSES INTIRELY FORBADE THE JEWS TO DO ANY SUCH THING.
list.label: III
list.item: HOW, AFTER THE DEATH OF CAMBYSES, AND THE SLAUGHTER OF THE MAGI, BUT UNDER THE REIGN OF DARIUS, ZOROBABEL WAS SUPERIOR TO THE REST IN THE SOLUTION OF PROBLEMS, AND THEREBY OBTAINED THIS FAVOUR OF THE KING, THAT THE TEMPLE SHOULD BE BUILT.
list.label: IV
list.item: HOW THE TEMPLE WAS BUILT, WHILE THE CUTHEANS ENDEAVOURED IN VAIN TO OBSTRUCT THE WORK.
list.label: V
list.item: HOW XERXES, THE SON OF DARIUS, WAS WELL-DISPOSED TO THE JEWS; AS ALSO CONCERNING ESDRAS AND NEHEMIAH.
list.label: VI
list.item: CONCERNING ESTHER, AND MORDECAI, AND HAMAN; AND HOW, IN THE REIGN OF ARTAXERXES, THE WHOLE NATION OF THE JEWS WAS IN DANGER OF PERISHING.
list.label: VII
list.item: HOW JOHN SLEW HIS BROTHER JESUS IN THE TEMPLE; AND HOW BAGOSES OFFERED MANY INJURIES TO THE JEWS; AND WHAT SANBALLAT DID.
list.label: VIII
list.item: CONCERNING SANBALLAT AND MANASSEH, AND THE TEMPLE WHICH THEY BUILT ON MOUNT GERIZZIM; AS ALSO HOW ALEXANDER MADE HIS ENTRY INTO THE CITY JERUSALEM; AND WHAT BENEFITS HE BESTOWED ON THE JEWS.
